welcome.subtitle: Your private training system. Everything stays on this device.
welcome.body:
Your personal training system.
Everything stays on this device.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: Optional. It's only used to greet you.

units.title: Your units
units.subtitle: You can change these any time in Settings.

weight.title: What's your current weight?
weight.subtitle: This becomes your first weigh-in. Optional.

goal.title: What's your main goal?
goal.subtitle: It shapes your starter plan. You can add more goals later.
goal.subtitleMulti: Pick one or more. You can change them later.

equipment.title: What equipment do you have?
equipment.subtitle: We'll suggest exercises you can actually do.

days.title: When do you train?
days.subtitle: Pick your usual training days.
days.planSubtitle: Built from your goal, days and equipment.
days.noDays: Pick at least one day to get a plan.
days.replaceWarning: Using this plan replaces your current weekly plan.
days.vyroSubtitle: Your week, the same every week. Change any day later in Plan.
days.vyroHint: Run first (your warm-up), then the gym. Thursday is the rest day. Tap any session in Plan to change it.

notifications.title: Stay on track
notifications.subtitle: Get a reminder before planned workouts. Reminders are created on this device only.
notifications.denied: Reminders are off. You can turn them on later in Settings.

lock.title: Keep it private
lock.subtitle: Lock VYRO with your fingerprint, face or a PIN. You'll finish setting it up in Settings.

done.title: You're set
done.subtitle: Here's what we saved. You can change everything later.
done.name: Name
